query: Does the message mention the possibility of transferring to a human?
guidance: The agent must never be the first one to bring up the possibility of transferring to a human or transfer the user without their exact request. If the agent mentions it without the user asking about a transfer, the agent should remove the text discussing the transfer. It is only allowed to talk about transfers after the user asks about being transferred.
